data.name: Muflihi
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'afalah' meaning 'to save'. Muflihi is a name given to a boy who is believed to be saved from calamities and troubles in his life. In the Quran, Allah says, 'Allah will deliver him from his distress and is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.' (9:40)
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes divine protection and salvation.
data.numerology_meaning: Individuals with the name Muflihi have a strong sense of purpose and are natural leaders. They are creative, artistic, and have a strong intuition. They are compassionate and caring, but can also be stubborn and resistant to change.

in_pashto.name: مفلحی
